simple.meaning: יֹאשִׁיָּה (Yôʼshîyâh) appears 53 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship and in connection with priesthood. The surrounding account also brings the name into death.

definitions.short: Joshijah , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H2977. Yoshiyyah or Yoshiyyahu יאֹשִׁיָּה יאֹשִׁיָּ֫הוּ, proper name, masculine ( ׳י supporteth ) 1 יאֹשִׁיָּהוּ king of Judah, son of Amon 1Kin 13:2 ; 2Kin 21:24 , 26 11 t. Kings, + 19 t. Chronicles, + 17 t. Jeremiah + Zeph 1:1 ; also יאֹו֯שִׁיָּהוּ Jer 27:1 . 2 יאֹשִׁיָּה a returned exile Zech 6:10 . אִשָּׁה see below III. אנשׁ .
definitions.rootNote: or יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ ; from the same root as 803 and 3050 ; founded of Jah ;
